title: Operational record persistence
description: Inspect and preserve the published operational record format through exact candidate validation, conflict-aware atomic publication, and explicit recovery.
responsibilities: Read coherent operational-record snapshots and expose recorded values separately from observations.
Validate supported record kinds and construct exact lossless candidates for explicit targeted edits.
Enforce revision, identity, byte-preservation, transaction, and recovery guarantees at the authoritative write boundary.
Inspect explicitly selected safe subject bytes and their identities for caller-owned decision bases; do not choose those subjects or rewrite prior expectations during a later mutation.
owned_state: Current operational record bytes, storage revisions, coherent snapshot identity, and transaction/recovery bookkeeping under the existing Record Format and CLI contracts.
Transient subject identity/content observations used for declared read sets; the inspected external project files remain outside this Module's mutation authority.

includes: Published v3 record inspection, structural checking, exact candidate construction, coherent publication, and recovery.
Read-only byte identity and optional full-content inspection of explicitly selected project subjects used by the operational record safety contract.
excludes: Engineering judgment or progression policy, implicit stored-format migration, interpretation of the new REM model collections, or publication/installation authority.

design_limits: This responsibility is distinct from MOD-001 Engineering model storage, whose first draft concerns REM definitions and does not select these operational-format or transaction guarantees.
All existing CLI atomicity, exact-byte preservation, external-edit limits, and recovery rules remain applicable. No weaker guarantee is inferred from IF-001.
Detailed ARs and executable implementation mapping remain deferred; current record-store code and Designs retain their existing authority.

sources.basis: Proposed responsibility derived from the published-product source inventory. Existing Designs retain their detailed contracts; this allocation is not a runtime migration or approval.
